name: The architects of the Committee Inferior
description: [[General Anailís]], Warden of the Upper Reaches for the [[Committee Exterior]], was one of the Principal Architects of the [[Committee Inferior]].

The arrival on [[Inis Mara]] of the forebears of the [[Engineers]], year 0 óT (the present day is 812 óT). They came from hotter, unknown climes, and found the island sparsely peopled by a people who looked different: slightly paler, and of the subtropics. The newcomers brought more advanced farming, and quickly intermingled with the people they found; the Engineers are both. None of this is in the histories they tell, even to themselves.
